title: Outlook: Copilot provides coaching feedback in chat as you draft, edit and format emails
description: Copilot now provides coaching feedback on email drafts via chat and can apply suggestions directly to your message in Outlook. Users have the option to choose which suggestions are applied, and Copilot updates your email in place.
